newsitem.title: GERMANY: Linotype says 96 net parent loss 280 mln dmk.
newsitem.headline: Linotype says 96 net parent loss 280 mln dmk.

text.p: German printing machinery group Linotype-Hell AG said on Wednesday it incurred a net loss of about 280 million marks at parent company level in 1996 including an operating loss of 73 million marks.
The net loss figure takes into account all costs resulting from current restructuring measures as well as writedowns on foreign shareholdings, Linotype said in a mandatory statement.

Linotype said its parent company, Heidelberger Druckmaschinen AG, had approved an injection of 125 million marks which was included in 1996 accounts and thereby reduced the parent loss to about 157 million marks.
At group level, the loss including the injection from Heidelberger Druck totalled about 144 million marks. Group sales amounted to 822 million marks, Linotype said.
Heidelberger Druck is a subsidiary of Rheinelektra AG.
